title: QA Automation Engineer
description: We are looking for a QA Automation Engineer to build reliable automated tests that keep our applications stable. You will write Selenium-based browser tests in JavaScript and contribute to our shared test automation framework. You will cover API flows, wire test suites into CI/CD, and track coverage and results in Jira and TestRail. If you are detail-oriented and passionate about shipping high-quality software, this role is for you.
